metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**Project structure** (under `/workspace/output/`):
- `Cargo.toml` - Standard package manifest with empty `[dependencies]`
- `src/main.rs` - CLI argument parsing, file I/O, main loop
- `src/lexer.rs` - Tokenizer that handles whitespace, comments, messages
- `src/parser.rs` - Block parser with full expression evaluator (binary ops, unary ops, parameter refs)
- `src/state.rs` - Machine state model (position, modal codes, parameters, tools)
- `src/interp.rs` - Main interpreter following Table 8 execution order
- `src/trace.rs` - Trace recorder with snapshot-diffing
- `src/io.rs` - Parameter/tool file readers and writers
- `src/json.rs` - Custom JSON writer (no external deps)

**Implemented features**:
- All G codes: G0-G4, G10, G17-G21, G28, G30, G38.2, G40-G42, G43/G49, G53-G59.3, G61/G61.1/G64, G80-G89, G90/G91, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3, G93/G94, G98/G99
- All M codes: M0-M9, M30, M48/M49, M60
- F/S/T/D/H words
- Parameter expressions with all unary/binary operations
- Parameter and tool file I/O per RS274 section 2.3 and 3.2.1
- Three trace stepping modes: time-step, distance-step, position-tolerance
- Block-delete switch, percent demarcation
- Probe box with G38.2 trip detection
- Helical arcs across all three planes
- Canned cycle expansion with correct sub-motion timing including G83 peck retry-back-off and G87 back-boring
- M2/M30 program-end reset with post-motion delta folding

**Verified against spec examples**: The three trace examples in the prompt (linear motion, G81 expansion, G43 H99 error) all produce correct output. The Hello World program from Appendix C runs to completion. Builds cleanly with `cargo build --release` and runs via `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- <args>`.
